scope: Retriangulate retained V6f planar surface patches; preserve geometry and editable STEP master
retriangulation: Native PyMesh/Triangle quality refinement of source triangles in needle-containing connected planar patches; fixed source boundaries and vertices, new interior points only on source planes
protected_interfaces: Curved bore and end-eye triangles unchanged; planar central pad and end seating regions preserve their entire surface through convex coplanar diagonal swaps
surface_distance_sampling: Every input/output vertex and face centroid, plus 100000 deterministic area-weighted points in each direction
